cases.name: worked_example_inputs_default
cases.note: The frozen worked example inputs (fixture) on the DEFAULT path with the TET rate left to the statute: shallow water 50,000 bopd weighted 5/7.5/12.5 (REGS r.13(2)(d)) = 11.25%, NDDC in the HCT base, TET 3% (FA23 s.26), capital allowance 20% in year one, CPR on liquids revenue. The default-path regression reference.

cases.name: ekene_alpha_shallow_converted_nta
cases.note: Ekene synthetic: shallow water (35 m) converted PML inside the small-field tranche (about 8,000 bopd falling), gas at 3 USD/Mscf, condensate 4%, 2026-2032 all under the NTA: levy 4%, no CITA restriction, 20% capital allowance.

cases.name: ekene_onshore_across_2026
cases.note: Ekene synthetic onshore converted PML 2024-2028 at about 7,000 bopd: 2024-2025 under the PIA (TET 3%, CITA two-thirds, 20/20 capital allowance), 2026 onward under the NTA (levy, no restriction, 20%); one ledger, the framework read per year.

cases.name: ekene_deep_new_60k_aggressive
cases.note: Ekene synthetic deep offshore new PML at 60,000 bopd (weighted 5% on 50,000, 7.5% above: REGS r.13(1)); 2025 under the PIA: no HCT (s.260(3)); 2026-2027 under the NTA read "aggressive_pml_30": HCT 30% and NO production allowance (NTA Sixth Schedule 1(2)).

cases.name: ekene_deep_new_60k_conservative
cases.note: The same deep offshore field read "conservative_zero" under the NTA.

cases.name: ekene_nag_gas_in_country_half
cases.note: Ekene synthetic gas field in shallow water: 20 Bscf a year at 3 USD/Mscf, half utilised in-country (royalty 2.5%), half at 5%; no crude oil so no HCT, a CPR cap of zero and CIT on the whole profit.

cases.name: ekene_onshore_new_cap_crossing
cases.note: Ekene synthetic new onshore PML with 49 MMbbl produced before 2026: 2026 crosses 50 MMbbl, the barrels below earn min(8, 20% of price), the rest min(4, 20% of price) (Sixth Schedule 1(2)(a)); HCT at the stated 15%.

cases.name: ekene_condensate_price_royalty_regs
cases.note: Crude at 95 and condensate at 88 USD/bbl in 2025: each pays royalty by price at its own price (REGS r.15(2)), benchmarks 54.12 / 108.24 / 162.36 (Regulations base, 2021).

cases.name: ekene_condensate_price_royalty_act
cases.note: The same year on the Act's base (2020): benchmarks 55.20 / 110.41 / 165.61.

cases.name: ekene_cpr_binding_forfeiture
cases.note: Ekene synthetic shallow water field with heavy costs on thin revenue: the 65% CPR binds on the HCT base only, carries, and is forfeited at cessation; the CIT base deducts full opex; the CITA two-thirds limit binds in 2024-2025.

cases.name: ekene_sinking_fund_nta_escrow_met
cases.note: NTA years with a decommissioning fund: deductible for HCT (inside the CPR) and CIT because the escrow condition is met (NTA s.86).

cases.name: ekene_sinking_fund_nta_escrow_not_met
cases.note: The same fund with the escrow condition not met: no deduction (NTA s.86), the cash still goes out.

cases.name: ekene_sinking_fund_pia_years
cases.note: A fund in PIA years (2024-2025): deductible without condition (PIA s.263(1)(e), s.302(11)(b)(i)).

cases.name: ekene_min_etr_nta_only
cases.note: Minimum ETR switched on at 85% (to force a top-up): the 2025 PIA year pays none, the 2026 NTA year pays the top-up (NTA s.57).

cases.name: ekene_alpha_wi_50
cases.note: Ekene Alpha at a 50% working interest: every money line halves, tranches and caps stay field-level.

cases.name: ekene_marginal_shallow_flag
cases.note: A producing marginal field converted under s.94(1), in shallow water at about 20,000 bopd: royalty weighted 5/7.5/12.5, HCT 15%.

cases.name: ekene_frontier
cases.note: Frontier acreage: royalty 7.5% flat, no royalty by price, no HCT (s.260(3); para 11(2)).

cases.name: ekene_nddc_opex_base
cases.note: NDDC on the stated opex base instead of the total annual budget.

cases.name: ekene_force_pia_2027
cases.note: A 2027 ledger forced to the PIA terms: TET 3%, CITA two-thirds, 20/20/20/20/19 allowance.

description: Goldens for the PIA 2021 / NTA 2025 default path of engines/economics/cashflow.ts (engines 3.12.0), from the independent stdlib oracle tools/validation/economics/oracle_pia2021.py written from the gazetted texts (PIA 2021 Gazette No. 142 of 27 Aug 2021; NTA 2025 Gazette No. 117 of 26 Jun 2025; Petroleum Royalty Regulations 2022 S.I. 73; Finance Act 2023; read 2026-09-26). Ekene cases are synthetic (ours).

act_example.text: PIA Seventh Schedule para 11(1): "if in 2020 the price is US $75 per barrel, the royalty by price shall be 2.5%"

units: money USD, volumes bbl and Mscf, rates as fractions, *_pct as percent
